name: arkadaz
description: Harness engineering and code quality skills for AI coding agents.

plugins.name: tiger-skills
plugins.description: Harness engineering + code quality skills. 19 skills, 5 agents, 1 command, and two deterministic workflows. Build pipeline: grill (merged markdown feature.md + broad Robot e2e, cuts feature/<id> from dev) → lead (the merged architect + e2e gate: plan + tiger/CODEBASE_MAP.md, spawns tiger-code-generator subagents in parallel git worktrees with TDD + simplify + no comments, then authors + runs the Robot suite for real as the single quality gate — Playwright for UI, triage by priority, in-context delta re-plan) → update-docs (refresh markdown docs, fast-forward merge to dev; main protected, dev→main manual). tiger-security / tiger-reviewer are standalone on-demand gates. Second workflow — the git-free research loop (/research-goal then /research-workflow): an autonomous, self-deliberating series of genuinely-different experiments (a novelty engine forbids parameter tuning; web/arxiv-grounded; results in local research/<goalId>/experimentN/ folders). Skills are independent units; agents bundle skills.
